canonicalCards.recommendedFirstExperiment: Loop the busiest representative passage and shorten decay until the tail clears before it masks the next phrase, then lengthen only if the musical space still feels too small.
stopOrUndo: Stop or back off when the intended space improves but clarity, groove, tone, mono translation, or section contrast becomes worse.
